activation: Explicit owner+local-admin+loopback start on existing shared session and expected checkpoint. No automatic start, cron, new daemon, world bootstrap, reset or production migration.

clock.mapping: For a newly observed explicit plan/turn, map world simulation timestamp P to G+(P-S), with G ground simtime and S exact source-world simtime at immutable journal acceptance. Freeze this bridge for that intent; do not backdate credit.
clock.navigationGate: Require the actual shared replay raw active step to match the intended plan hash/index/location; clocks or step disagreement cannot yield completion.
clock.pause: Zero simulation delta earns no dwell/contact/speech duration. Accepted pause/scale/source boundaries retain replay order.
clock.window: Half-open step windows; interval closure precedes a source adoption at the exact boundary. Late/cancelled/replaced/retired plans cannot complete.

outcomes.baseline: Existing plans and new actor seed plans are baselines, never historical arrival. Only later observed plan replacements are tracked.
outcomes.arrival: Bind actor epoch, exact raw plan SHA, source revision/seq, step index/window, requested+routed navigation goal and actual server pose. Distinguish already-present from observed movement. No camera, ETA, declared location or client position proof.
outcomes.fulfillment: presence-completed only: goal arrival and continuous stationary presence for at least38% of the declared step window, then full window closure without replacement/exit. This is simulated presence fulfillment, not productive/economic/medical effects.
outcomes.unsupported: Unknown/malformed/legacy plans without explicit simulation anchor, transit/boarding/motorbike/plane and moving games/exercise do not receive unsupported completion labels.

encounter.participants: All current human actors in authoritative shared replay; renderer subset/selection is irrelevant.
encounter.visibility: Conservative swept/static footprint clearance; no meeting through walls. Reset on separation, retirement or source epoch change.
encounter.knowledge: Witnessed co-presence only for the two participants, not arbitrary facts/actions. No camera-derived witnesses.

speech.source: Only a fresh committed server LivingTurn for its exact two plan-bound participants. Baseline turns, viewer-local/editorial ambient scripts and public availability are not emissions.
speech.earliest: Map turn.simStartedAt+120000ms through the frozen source bridge; never emit before capture or outside both participant plan windows.
speech.emission: Server observer explicitly starts an utterance only after verified co-presence, matching plans/goals, stationary bodies and clear static sightline. Planned text alone is not heard.
speech.heard: Only the named other participant gets a heard-utterance receipt after the whole emitted window stays valid; interruption/pause/source replacement cannot fabricate delivery. Text is hearsay, not witnessed truth.
speech.viewer: Shared mode may display only authoritative server utterances with matching shared checkpoint/sample time; cosmetic gestures cannot alter roots. No TTS/audio or LLM-thinking claim.

persistence.namespace: Independent authority checkpoint/batch ledger, append-only migration0011; active marker binds existing shared state.
persistence.atomicity: Authority state/records, shared state/source cursor and base receipt commit together under exact CAS and SQL postassert. Silent ignore/abort/concurrency/lost ACK cannot create partial credit.
persistence.preflight: Once active, incomplete schema/state/receipt fails before ordinary pulse world writes. Missing0011 remains optional for inactive GND2.
persistence.preserve: World revision/born/IDs/history/memories/policies/earned samples remain untouched by authority accounting.

consumerPolicy.reason: Future H3b/H5 require their own feature/reward/sharing namespace and measured admission. GND1/GND2 or simulation-plan-time evidence is not relabelled.

acceptance: Pure deterministic resume/chunk/source/clock equivalence, all-actor accounting and finite budgets.
Arrival/presence window, cancellation/removal/baseline/unsupported and clock mismatch negatives.
Encounter duration/separation/LOS and explicit emission/full delivery/recipient isolation; planned/partial text never knowledge.
Native SQLite and compiled D1 strict guards/missing schema/no bootstrap/atomic start/advance/concurrency/retry and silent-ignore rollback.
Fresh shared browser two viewers authoritative text/camera/F5/pause/no root mutation, actual screenshots; default renderer regressions.
Full unit/type/lint/assets/build/API; keep research negatives and live/remote blockers.
